card.name: Word just before a comma or timing phrase
card.fires_on: The last word of a clause, such as a body part, 'orally', 'each', 'morning' or a unit, right where a comma or a timing phrase is expected next. Seen mostly in instructions and dosing sentences.

modes.label: Route word before schedule
modes.description: The word 'orally' after take or administered, just before a frequency like 'once daily'.
modes.example: Take SYNJARDY<< orally>> twice daily with meals; with gradual dose
